effect.name: GM Height Map
effect.desc: Treats the layer's luminance as a terrain height field and then renders that terrain six different ways. Shaded Relief lights it from an adjustable sun, Contour Lines draws isolines at a settable spacing, Emboss adds the relief back onto the original, Normal Map writes the surface normal as a colour, Displace actually pushes the layer's pixels along the slope, and Slate quantises the terrain into flat geological bands. Height scale, light angle and sun height, a pre-blur, and separate ink and paper colours. Measured in layer space, so the terrain is the layer's own.
